description: We're SAAI, a Trivandrum team tackling "Abandoned but Not Forgotten," telling the stories of NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars. We love space exploration, planets & moons, astrophysics, satellites and hardware. We're looking for teammates skilled in storytelling, writing, graphic design, video/animation or web development to turn mission history into an engaging experience. Beginners welcome! We speak English and Hindi.
